name: Agent asks about visit duration naturally
expected_behavior: Uses the hotel check-in and 'through Sunday' mentions to shape a multi-day experience plan. Suggests tonight's activities with awareness that more days are available for other experiences
expected_behavioral_quality: Learns visit duration through context rather than directly asking 'how long are you staying?' When the guest mentions hotel or multiple days, the agent can frame a multi-day plan. Otherwise, infers from cues like checkout or 'tomorrow'.

turns.user_message: We just checked into the Sky Tower
turns.agent_response:
Welcome to the Sky Tower. Your room will serve as a peaceful retreat with those panoramic views of the Thames River valley and the Connecticut countryside as the sun comes up.

Since you have arrived quite early in the morning, please keep in mind that our standard check-out time is 11:00 AM on the day of your departure. If you find yourself needing a bit more rest before you head out later this week, Momentum members at higher tiers may be eligible for a complimentary late check-out based on availability. 

The Casino of the Sky is just a short walk away if you are looking for an early breakfast or a quiet place to start your day. Are you visiting us for a special occasion or just a quick getaway?

A long weekend is the perfect amount of time to experience the resort without feeling rushed.

Since you are here through Sunday, you will have access to the full weekend lineup at the Mohegan Sun Arena and the nightlife at novelle, which is open Thursday through Saturday. For a memorable dinner, Todd English’s Tuscany is a guest favorite for its terrace views of the 55-foot indoor waterfall. Will you be dining as a couple or with a larger group this weekend?

Comix Roadhouse also starts its weekend comedy schedule this evening if you're in the mood for some laughs. 

After a late night out, the Elemis Spa is a great place to reset with a massage tomorrow morning. Are you looking for a high-energy evening or a more relaxed start to your trip?
